# Virtual Agentic Machine (VAM) Documentation for LLMs

> VAM is a Rust workspace for designing and running autonomous AI agents inside isolated Firecracker microVMs with AWS Cedar security policies, zero-trust egress proxies, and Drive9 storage.

## Agent Reference Endpoints
- Complete Agent Cheatsheet: https://vam.dev/agent.md
- Full LLM Documentation Bundle: https://vam.dev/llms-full.txt

## Developer Guides & Getting Started
- Quickstart (5 Min): https://vam.dev/getting-started/quickstart/ - 5-minute guide to boot daemon, store secrets, run agent, and test HITL approval.
- Installation & Setup: https://vam.dev/getting-started/installation/ - How to build vam CLI, configure VAM_HOST, and connect remote clients.
- CLI Command Reference: https://vam.dev/getting-started/cli/ - Complete command reference for runs, approvals, secrets, sessions, keys, and catalog specs.

## Specification Authoring
- Agent Specifications (agent.json): https://vam.dev/authoring/agent-spec/ - Defining agent identities, system instructions, model preferences, reasoning budgets, and skill pins.
- Skills & Frontmatter (SKILL.md): https://vam.dev/authoring/skill-manifest/ - Authoring YAML frontmatter tool schemas, unprivileged execution runners, and Layer 2 instructions.
- Run Specifications (run.json): https://vam.dev/authoring/run-spec/ - Binds agents to Drive9 volumes, threads, and prompts with execution budgets.
- Playbooks (playbook.json): https://vam.dev/authoring/playbook-spec/ - Prose on every step, with an optional tool binding and mode bound, assisted, or agentic.

## In-VM Tool Development & Zero-Trust Proxies
- Writing In-VM Tools: https://vam.dev/tools/writing-tools/ - MicroVM sandbox environment, dropped privileges (uid=1000, gid=100), and stdin/stdout JSON protocol.
- Tool Runtime Templates: https://vam.dev/tools/tool-runtimes/ - Ready-to-use boilerplates for Bun, Node.js, Python 3, and Bash executors.
- Zero-Trust Egress Proxy Architecture: https://vam.dev/integrations/egress-proxy-deepdive/ - Host-brokered secret injection, scheme-less placeholders (vamsec_*), X-Target-Url routing, and domain allowlists.
- Jira Assistant Integration Walkthrough: https://vam.dev/integrations/jira-assistant-walkthrough/ - Step-by-step case study tracing SKILLS.md, execute.js proxy calls, vault secrets, and Cedar rules.

## Security Governance & HITL
- Cedar Security Policies & HITL: https://vam.dev/security/cedar-and-hitl/ - Authoring AWS Cedar policies for ExecuteTool, ReadFile, and WriteFile with hitl_approved gating.
- Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Lifecycle: https://vam.dev/security/hitl-lifecycle/ - The two-pass execution model: Suspend -> vam approve decide -> Resume.
- Secrets Vault Management: https://vam.dev/security/secret-management/ - Storing inference API keys and zero-trust egress tokens with encryption at rest and redaction.

## Tutorials & Recipes
- Jira Assistant Tutorial: https://vam.dev/tutorials/jira-assistant/ - Hands-on tutorial running the autonomous Jira Assistant and completing an HITL approval.
- Bun Assistant Tutorial: https://vam.dev/tutorials/bun-assistant/ - Multi-turn workspace file creation and thread persistence on Drive9 volumes.
